text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's finally the day of Agnes Tachyon's
debut race.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
choice_data_list: もしかして、緊張してる？

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I was lamenting over the fact that I ran
out of
black tea in the lab. How
unbecoming of me to
forget to restock,
no?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know. You can go out to purchase
some for
me while I race. Ceylon or
Keemun is my
preference.
choice_data_list: （デビュー戦と全然関係ない……！）

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, would you look at the time. It
appears I
must get going.
choice_data_list: 君のレースを観ないわけには――
貴方のレースを観ないわけには――

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you can't find either of the two I
mentioned,
Assam tea will also do.
Would you be so kind as
to deliver it to
my lab?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon saunters out of the
waiting room.
